summary: Branch and approval rules use default deny, fixed self-registration roles, validated state transitions, sanitized cross-branch candidate collections, and atomic relationship checks. The remaining material concern is that same-branch staff access to the existing users documents includes profile PII; this is required by the current management UI but would be safer with a future public/private profile split.

findings.issue: No bypass found: self-registration is fixed to guard/pending, self role updates cannot grant privileges, and pending transitions require an existing admin plus atomic related writes.
findings.recommendation: Keep emulator regression tests for pending-to-approved/rejected transitions when fields are added.

findings.issue: Same-branch staff can read existing users documents containing address and contact data because current staff management and proxy-entry screens require those fields.
findings.recommendation: In a later migration, split operational display data from private contact/address data and grant private-profile access only to explicitly authorized office roles.

findings.issue: No direct cross-branch users read is granted. Candidate profile and assignment documents are sanitized and writes are checked against authoritative users, userRoles, availability, and shiftGroups documents.
findings.recommendation: Keep the sanitized indexes synchronized in every future shift and availability mutation path.

attacks.publicList: blocked by authentication and default deny
attacks.schemaPollution: blocked on all new documents by hasOnly
attacks.candidateProfileSpoof: blocked by authoritative getAfter equality checks
attacks.candidateAvailabilitySpoof: blocked by matching availability getAfter checks
attacks.candidateAssignmentSpoof: blocked by matching shiftGroup getAfter checks
attacks.adminMembershipMutationFromBranchSwitch: not performed; selection is local UI state
attacks.legacyBranchEscalation: blocked; admin-only, operational guard/staff only, missing-to-valid branch only, and users/userRoles must match after the batch
